capabilities: delete all properties of the current note in one click
undo the deletion via a notice link or Ctrl/Cmd+Z
run deletion from a command, hotkey, or mobile toolbar
remove frontmatter in both editing and reading view
keep the delete line always visible on touch screens
extras: The plugin listing carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." It has no settings.
intentEvidence: adds a thin line to the left of a note's properties
problem: Obsidian only lets you delete properties one at a time, each through its own menu, which is slow when cleaning up old notes.
summary: Properties-block helper that adds a hover trash button deleting all YAML frontmatter of a note in one click, with undo.
